"""Merge overlapping or touching integer intervals."""


def merge(intervals):
    """Return merged disjoint intervals sorted by start.

    Overlapping or touching intervals ([1, 3] and [3, 5]) are combined.
    The input list and its pairs are never modified.
    """
    merged = []
    for start, end in sorted((list(pair) for pair in intervals)):
        if merged and start <= merged[-1][1]:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], end)
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])
    return merged


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert merge([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]) == [[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]
    assert merge([[1, 4], [4, 5]]) == [[1, 5]]
    assert merge([[5, 6], [1, 2]]) == [[1, 2], [5, 6]]
    assert merge([]) == []
    original = [[3, 4], [1, 2]]
    merge(original)
    assert original == [[3, 4], [1, 2]]
    print("ok")
